title: The COO Field Guide to Agentic AI: 10 Questions Operations Leaders Are Asking About Autonomous Factory and Supply Chain Execution
summary: The COO Field Guide to Agentic AI: 10 Questions Operations Leaders Are Asking About Autonomous Factory and Supply Chain Execution ARC Advisory Group
body: The COO Field Guide to Agentic AI: 10 Questions Operations Leaders Are Asking About Autonomous Factory and Supply Chain Execution ARC Advisory
summaryZh: ARC Advisory发布了面向COO的Agentic AI实地指南，提出了运营领导者在评估自主工厂与供应链执行时最关心的10个核心问题。该指南从实际运营角度剖析了智能体落地的痛点、ROI及管理挑战。原始信息显示：The COO Field Guide to Agentic AI: 10 Questions Operations Leaders Are Asking About Autonomous Factory and Supply Chain Execution ARC Advisory。该消息由ARC Advisory发布，主题为“The COO Field Guide to Agentic AI: 10 Questions Operations Leaders Are Asking About Autonomous Factory and Supply Chain Execution”。其重要性主要体现在：面向运营负责人的智能体指南探讨了自主工厂和供应链执行中的关键问题，对产业落地有指导意义。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
